verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a code host, but the pack has no first-party evidence that GitHub shows or manages external-tracker tickets inside GitHub, or links to them from pull requests. The only related item is a marketplace listing for 'GitHub for Atlassian'. It is a third-party ecosystem app that describes syncing development data from GitHub into Jira, not viewing or managing Jira tickets within GitHub, so it earns no credit.
